plan.description: Read-only integrity audit for Hermes ledger runs and artifacts.

entries.task: Implement Task M1A from the Trust Release plan at docs/plans/2026-06-15-trust-release/00-strategy.md. Create scripts/db_anomaly.py with AnomalyChecker (known-bad SHA detection, row-count-drop detection, manifest writer). Create tests/scripts/test_db_anomaly.py (4 TDD tests: clean db, known bad sha, row count drop, manifest written). TDD order: write failing tests first, verify RED, implement minimal code, verify GREEN, commit. Exact code is in the plan.

Implement Task M1A (Trust Release plan). Read the full task at docs/plans/2026-06-15-trust-release/00-strategy.md section 'Task M1A'. Create scripts/db_anomaly.py with class AnomalyChecker(db_path, known_bad_shas_path=None, watermark_path=None, output_path=None) and dataclass AnomalyResult(ok, anomaly_type, detail, evidence). AnomalyChecker.check() detects known_bad_sha (from known_bad_shas.json) and row_count_drop (vs watermark min_row_count), writes manifest JSON if output_path set. Create tests/scripts/test_db_anomaly.py with 4 tests: clean_db_no_anomalies, known_bad_sha_flagged, row_count_drop_flagged, manifest_written_on_check. TDD: write tests first, run to see RED, then implement, run to see GREEN, then git commit.

Implement Task M2 (Trust Release plan). Read docs/plans/2026-06-15-trust-release/00-strategy.md section 'Task M2'. Create scripts/run_migration.py with class MigrationRunner(db_path, target_version, writer_check_timeout=5.0) and MigrationError. run() calls _assert_no_active_writers() (spins on BEGIN EXCLUSIVE lock, raises MigrationError if timeout exceeded), then applies v52 ALTER TABLE (rows_returned_this_iter INTEGER, rows_after_filter_this_iter INTEGER, last_failure_mode TEXT) idempotently, bumps schema_version table. Create tests/scripts/test_run_migration.py with 4 tests: adds_v52_columns, bumps_schema_version, fails_if_writer_detected, is_idempotent. TDD: write tests first RED, implement GREEN, git commit.

Implement Task M3 (Trust Release plan). Read docs/plans/2026-06-15-trust-release/00-strategy.md section 'Task M3'. 1) Add REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION=2, VALID_STATUSES set (including api_shape_changed and fresh_empty_expected), and CollectorHealthReport dataclass to ops/collector_health.py WITHOUT removing existing code. 2) Create storage/collector_suspension.py with class SuspensionStore(path): file-backed JSON, suspend(collector,reason) and reset(collector,reset_by) write to file, is_suspended() returns False when HARMONIC_SCRATCH_DB=1 env var is set (scratch guard), audit_log() returns list of action dicts. 3) Create tests/ops/test_collector_health_v2.py with 6 tests: schema_version_is_2, api_shape_changed_valid, fresh_empty_expected_valid, suspension_persists_to_file, suspension_not_written_in_scratch_mode, suspension_reset_writes_audit_entry. TDD: RED then GREEN then commit.

Implement Task M4 (Trust Release plan). Read docs/plans/2026-06-15-trust-release/00-strategy.md section 'Task M4'. 1) Create tests/cassettes/.gitkeep (empty file). 2) Create tests/support/cassette_policy.py with class CassettePolicy(cassette_path, fingerprint_path, meta_path=None) and StaleCassetteError. assert_fresh() raises StaleCassetteError if .meta.json fingerprint differs from current fingerprint file. assert_no_synthetic_field_injection() raises StaleCassetteError if cassette contains __synthetic__, __injected__, or __default__ markers. 3) Create tests/support/test_cassette_policy.py with 4 tests: fresh_cassette_passes, stale_cassette_raises, cassette_does_not_mask_api_shape_changed, cassette_storage_is_under_tests_cassettes. TDD: RED then GREEN then commit.

Implement Task M5 (Trust Release plan). Read docs/plans/2026-06-15-trust-release/00-strategy.md section 'Task M5'. First check if scripts/ci/run_thesis_parity_gate.py exists — if yes extend it, if not create it. Add/define: dataclass ParityGateConfig(temperature=0.0, accuracy_delta_threshold=0.02, seed=42, max_retries=2), dataclass ParityGateResult(passed, cli_accuracy, api_accuracy, delta, reason), class ParityGateError(RuntimeError), class ParityGate(config=None) with evaluate(cli_correct, api_correct, total) -> ParityGateResult (passed when abs delta <= threshold). Create tests/scripts/test_thesis_parity_gate.py with 5 tests: temperature_zero_by_default, rejects_delta_exceeding_threshold, passes_within_threshold, passes_when_exactly_equal, config_documents_seed_and_retries. TDD: RED then GREEN then commit.

Implement Task M6 (Trust Release plan). Read docs/plans/2026-06-15-trust-release/00-strategy.md section 'Task M6'. Create scripts/check_pr_evidence.py with class EvidenceError(RuntimeError) and class EvidenceChecker with check(body: str) -> None. check() raises EvidenceError when: body is empty, body has no evidence trigger phrases (test results:, artifact links:), body has trigger phrases but no real GitHub Actions URLs matching https://github.com/org/repo/actions/runs/DIGITS pattern, or evidence lines contain placeholder indicators (see ci, see above, passing, n/a, none, tbd) without a real URL. Create tests/scripts/test_check_pr_evidence.py with 5 tests: good_evidence_passes, placeholder_evidence_fails, empty_body_fails, body_with_phrase_but_no_links_fails, known_ci_url_pattern_accepted. TDD: RED then GREEN then commit.
harden PR evidence checker gate against wrong-repo and zero run id risk
Phase 3 PR Evidence Gate always-run self-protecting required check
Phase 4 fence off legacy migration surface guard test docs to storage.migrations
Phase 5 restore_db Litestream mode B off and maintenance lock timeout
Phase 6 add workflow contract tests litestream restore verify local artifact dry-run canary
Phase 7 hermes runbook add ledger-audit and force-unlock commands docs
